run_async_grpc_auth_client: run the async gRPC client with customized authentication against a helloworld server on a given port
create_client_channel: create a secure gRPC async channel with composite SSL and metadata call credentials
build_auth_gateway_plugin: build a custom gRPC AuthMetadataPlugin that signs RPCs with a reversed method name header
send_rpc_greeter: send an async SayHello RPC request to a gRPC Greeter stub over a secure channel
review_authgateway_call: review the AuthGateway __call__ method that generates a signature from the RPC method name
